summary: This note describes "Addicted", a song by Ace Young and his second single after "Scattered" (2006). It is the first and only single from his self-titled 2008 CD. The song was written by Desmond Child and Andreas Carlsson and produced by Desmond Child.
one_line: "Addicted" is Ace Young's 2008 single from his self-titled CD, written by Desmond Child and Andreas Carlsson.
key_facts: "Addicted" is Ace Young's second single, after his 2006 song "Scattered".
"Addicted" is the first and only single from Ace Young's self-titled 2008 CD.
"Addicted" was written by Desmond Child and Andreas Carlsson.
Andreas Carlsson was part of the team who wrote for the Backstreet Boys.
